title: [05.10] Two-part: Chiến lược tăng doanh số - Các phương pháp & Đâu là cách tối ưu nhất?
prompt: There are different methods businesses use to increase their sales. What are the different ways companies use to increase sales? Which one is the most effective?
guide:
### 📌 HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT TỪNG BƯỚC CHI TIẾT (TRẠM IELTS)

---
### PHẦN 1: INTRODUCTION (2 câu)

#### Bước 1: Paraphrase đề bài
* **Mục tiêu:** Giới thiệu sự cạnh tranh trên thương trường và nhu cầu áp dụng các kỹ thuật kích cầu.
* **Công thức:** `In an increasingly competitive global marketplace, commercial enterprises employ various commercial strategies to boost their revenue.`
* **Từ vựng Band 7:** *commercial strategies (chiến lược thương mại), revenue / sales volume (doanh số), promotional tactics (chiêu thức khuyến mãi).*
* **Câu áp dụng:** *In an increasingly competitive marketplace, commercial enterprises employ various strategies to expand their sales volume.*

#### Bước 2: Thesis Statement (Trả lời trực tiếp 2 câu hỏi)
* **Mục tiêu:** Nêu các cách phổ biến (quảng cáo, giảm giá khuyến mãi, cải tiến sản phẩm) và khẳng định nâng cao chất lượng sản phẩm & chăm sóc khách hàng là hiệu quả nhất.
* **Công thức:** `This essay will discuss advertising campaigns and promotional discounts as common techniques, and argue that consistent product quality combined with customer service is the most effective long-term method.`
* **Câu áp dụng:** *This essay will examine digital advertising and promotional discounts as common commercial methods, and argue that delivering superior product quality is the most effective strategy for sustainable sales.*

---
### PHẦN 2: BODY 1 (CÁC PHƯƠNG THỨC DOANH NGHIỆP DÙNG ĐỂ TĂNG DOANH SỐ - 5 câu)

* **Câu 1 (Topic Sentence):** *Companies utilize multiple marketing channels and financial incentives to attract consumers and stimulate purchases.*
* **Câu 2 (Ý 1 - Quảng cáo số & Người nổi tiếng):** *The most widespread method is aggressive digital marketing through social media influencers and targeted online advertisements.*
* **Câu 3 (Ý 1 - CAR):** *This means that brands can expose their goods to millions of potential buyers instantly, leading to immediate brand awareness.*
* **Câu 4 (Ý 2 - Giảm giá & Khuyến mãi):** *In addition, firms frequently implement seasonal discounts, loyalty rewards programs, and buy-one-get-one-free promotions.*
* **Câu 5 (Ý 2 - Mở rộng):** *Instead of contemplating purchases cautiously, consumers are enticed by temporary bargains to spend money impulsively.*

---
### PHẦN 3: BODY 2 (PHƯƠNG THỨC HIỆU QUẢ VÀ BỀN VỮNG NHẤT - 5 câu)

* **Câu 1 (Topic Sentence):** *While flashy promotions generate temporary spikes in revenue, I believe that superior product quality is the single most effective sales driver.*
* **Câu 2 (Giải thích cốt lõi):** *Clever advertisements can convince an individual to buy an item once, but only exceptional functionality and durability inspire repeat purchases.*
* **Câu 3 (CAR):** *When customers are genuinely satisfied, they organically recommend the brand to friends and colleagues, generating powerful organic word-of-mouth marketing.*
* **Câu 4 (Ví dụ thực tế):** *Global tech leaders like Apple maintain massive worldwide sales largely because consumers trust their hardware reliability and ecosystem, even without offering price discounts.*
* **Câu 5 (Chốt hạ):** *Consequently, investing in research, development, and customer care creates brand loyalty that outlasts any short-term discount campaign.*

---
### PHẦN 4: CONCLUSION (2 câu)

* **Câu 1 (Tóm tắt Body 1):** *In conclusion, while businesses frequently utilize digital promotions and temporary discounts to attract customers and boost transactions.*
* **Câu 2 (Khẳng định Body 2):** *I maintain that maintaining exceptional product quality is the most reliable strategy to secure customer loyalty and achieve lasting sales success.*

---
### PHẦN 5: BÀI VIẾT HOÀN THIỆN (BAND 7.0)

In an increasingly competitive marketplace, commercial enterprises employ various strategies to expand their sales volume. This essay will examine digital advertising and promotional discounts as common commercial methods, and argue that delivering superior product quality is the most effective strategy for sustainable sales.

Companies utilize multiple marketing channels and financial incentives to attract consumers and stimulate purchases. The most widespread method is aggressive digital marketing through social media influencers and targeted online advertisements. This means that brands can expose their goods to millions of potential buyers instantly, leading to immediate brand awareness. In addition, firms frequently implement seasonal discounts, loyalty rewards programs, and buy-one-get-one-free promotions. Instead of contemplating purchases cautiously, consumers are enticed by temporary bargains to spend money impulsively.

While flashy promotions generate temporary spikes in revenue, I believe that superior product quality is the single most effective sales driver. Clever advertisements can convince an individual to buy an item once, but only exceptional functionality and durability inspire repeat purchases. When customers are genuinely satisfied, they organically recommend the brand to friends and colleagues, generating powerful organic word-of-mouth marketing. Global tech leaders like Apple maintain massive worldwide sales largely because consumers trust their hardware reliability and ecosystem, even without offering price discounts. Consequently, investing in research, development, and customer care creates brand loyalty that outlasts any short-term discount campaign.

In conclusion, while businesses frequently utilize digital promotions and temporary discounts to attract customers and boost transactions. I maintain that maintaining exceptional product quality is the most reliable strategy to secure customer loyalty and achieve lasting sales success.
